claim.claim-text: a piston chamber-forming member (12) and a piston-forming element (14) disposed about a common central axis (13) and coaxially slidable for reciprocal sliding motion inwardly and outwardly between an extended position, an intermediate position and a retracted position, the piston chamber-forming member (12) defines three coaxial cylindrical chambers of different diameters increasing in diameter from an inner end (330) to an open outer end (320) namely a first innermost chamber (301), a second intermediate chamber (302), and a third sealing outer chamber (303), each having a diameter larger than the diameter of the chamber axially inwardly therein and each having an outer end opening into the next adjacent outer placed chamber, a shoulder joins each of the adjacent chambers, each of the chambers (301), (302) and (303) have a radially inwardly directed wall (311), (312), and (313), respectively, characterized by:

a transfer port (31) is provided through the wall (312) of the intermediate chamber (302) proximate the shoulder joining the intermediate chamber (302) with the third chamber (303), the first chamber (301) is closed at the inner end (330) by an annular inner end wall (331) supporting an axially inwardly extending center post member (110) having a generally cylindrical post wall (114) closed at an outer end (113), the piston-forming element (14) comprising a central hollow piston stem (36) extending along the axis (13), the piston stem (36) has a central passageway (37) from a discharge outlet (15) at an outer end of the piston-forming element (14) through to an inner opening (39) at an upper inner end (203) of the piston-forming element (14), a foam inducing screen (64) disposed in the central passageway (37) spaced inwardly from the discharge outlet (15); an annular flow space (124) is defined between the post member (110) and the stem (36) within the passageway (37), the piston-forming element (14) carries two annular members which extend radially outwardly from the piston stem (36), namely, an outwardly extending first disc (321) proximate the inner end (203) of the piston-forming element (14) and an outwardly extending outer disc (322), the outer disc (322) engages the wall (313) of the outer chamber (303) to form a seal therewith preventing fluid flow axially outwardly therepast, the inner disc (321) is sized such that between the intermediate position and the retracted position, the inner disc (321) engages with the wall (311) of the inner chamber (301) to form a seal therewith preventing fluid flow axially outwardly therepast, the inner disc (321) is sized such that between the extended position and positions outward of the intermediate position, the inner disc (321) is spaced radially inwardly from the wall (312) of the intermediate chamber (302) to permit flow axially inwardly and outwardly therepast, wherein in a retraction stroke, the piston-forming element (14) is moved from the extended position to the intermediate position and then to the retracted position, while the piston-forming element (14) is in positions in which the inner disc (321) permits fluid flow axially therepast by the inner disc (321) being within the second chamber (302) and spaced from the respective wall (312) communication is provided between an interior of a bottle coupled to the pump from the transfer port (31) to the discharge outlet (15) via an annular space (222) from the transfer port (31) radially outwardly of the stem (36) and radially inwardly of the walls of the chambers to the inner end (203) of the piston-forming element (14) and then through the flow space (124) and the central passageway (37) of the stem (36) to the discharge outlet (15) permitting air to pass from the discharge outlet (15) into the bottle to relieve any vacuum which may be created within the bottle, and with liquid flow from the bottle to the discharge outlet (15) being prevented by the transfer port (31) being disposed at a height H2 below the upper inner end (203) of the piston-forming element (14), in the retraction stroke, once the piston-forming element (14) is moved inwardly to the intermediate position, a liquid pump (101) is formed with the inner disc (321) engaging the wall (311) of the inner chamber (301), wherein in movement from the intermediate position to the retracted position, fluid in a discharge compartment (349) defined inside the inner chamber (301) axially inwardly of the inner disc (321) and including the flow space (124) and the central passageway (37) is reduced in volume, and air and fluid within the discharge chamber (349) are compressed with movement between the intermediate position and the retracted position with liquid and air being simultaneously discharged through the foam inducing screen (64) and out the discharge outlet (15) as foam, in a withdrawal stroke on moving from the retracted position to the intermediate position, a volume within the discharge chamber (349) increases drawing air inwardly into the discharge chamber (349) via the discharge outlet (15), in the withdrawal stroke on moving from the retracted position to the intermediate position, a volume within an annular liquid compartment (350) outwardly of the stem (36) between the discs (321) and (322) inside the chambers (301), (302) and (303) increases drawing liquid into the annular liquid compartment (350) from the container via the transfer port (31), in the withdrawal stroke in moving from the intermediate position to the extended position, communication between the discharge outlet (15) and the transfer port (31) becomes open permitting air to flow from the discharge outlet (15) through the discharge compartment (349) to the transfer port (31) to relieve any vacuum which may have been developed in the bottle.

2. A piston pump as claimed in claim 1 wherein the outer disc (322) engages wall (313) of the outer chamber (303) to form a seal therewith preventing fluid flow axially outwardly therepast and axially inwardly therepast.

3. A piston pump as claimed in claim 1 or 2 wherein the inner disc (321) is sized such that between the intermediate position and the retracted position, the inner disc (321) engages with the wall (311) of the inner chamber (301) to form a seal therewith preventing fluid flow axially outwardly therepast and axially inwardly therepast.
4. A piston pump as claimed in claim 1, 2 or 3 wherein the bottle is a non-collapsible bottle in which a vacuum is created as liquid is dispensed from the bottle.
5. A piston pump as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 4 wherein the height H2 is chosen to be a height which restricts fluid flow from the bottle and air flow into the bottle.
6. A piston pump as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 5 including a second foam inducing screen (64a) disposed in the central passageway (37) spaced inwardly from the discharge outlet (15).

7. A piston pump as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 6 wherein in the withdrawal stroke in moving from the intermediate position to the extended position, the discharge compartment (349) increases in volume drawing air inwardly into the discharge compartment (349) from the discharge outlet (15).

8. A piston pump as claimed in any one of claims 1 to 6 wherein in the withdrawal stroke in moving from the intermediate position to the extended position, the discharge compartment (349) increases in volume drawing air inwardly from the discharge outlet (15) and drawing liquid and/or air axially inwardly past the inner disc (321) and axially outwardly through the flow space (124).
